overview: This 185-page file documents U.S. efforts to protect American trademarks in Japan from 1937 to 1941. Most records trace Greenfield Tap and Die Corporation’s GTD registration dispute, including appeals, invalidation proceedings, and Embassy advice. Other correspondence concerns the Underwood, “television,” “PURE,” and OTD marks.
interest: The GTD case reveals how a successful invalidation suit could still leave an American company’s registration blocked.
